description: The Washington, D.C. office of Congressman Joe Wilson (SC-02) is seeking motivated, organized, and reliable interns for the fall of 2018. Intern responsibilities include, but are not limited to, answering phones, conducting Capitol tours, sorting incoming mail, attending briefings, conducting legislative research and performing other administrative duties. Successful candidates will possess excellent written and oral communications skills, a strong attention to detail, an ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and an eagerness to learn. Southern ties are a plus.
qualifications: Excellent written and oral communications skills
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
how_to_apply: Please send a resume and cover letter to Joshua.Grant@mail.house.gov with "Fall 2018 Internship" in the subject line.
